releaseNotes.title: AIM figure integrity hardening
details: Bundled 207 unique visible AIM figures for offline reading.
Excluded blank image placeholders returned by FAA figure URLs.

releaseNotes.title: Study workflow hardening
details: Saved sections, notes, highlights, review queue, quizzes, flashcards, and certificate paths verified across web build checks.
Added portable study-pack export/import for saved notes, recent reading, and search history across supported platforms.
Added adjustable reader text size and spacing for FAR/AIM references.

limitations: Offline app content is a dated snapshot, not a substitute for official FAA/eCFR sources in operational decision-making.
FAA document pages remain the source of record for Advisory Circular details and downloads.
Extracted Advisory Circular text may omit pages, figures or exact layout when a record is marked partial; use its official PDF for source fidelity.
Cloud sync is not included; use study-pack export/import to move notes between devices.
nextChecks: Refresh AIM at next FAA publication cycle.
